article.story: FLORENCE, Ala. -- — Drey Carter had 16 points in North Alabama’s 87-49 victory against Fisk on Monday. Carter shot 7 of 14 from the field and 2 for 3 from the line for the Lions (3-2). Jacobe Whitted scored 12 points while shooting 6 for 11, including 0 for 4 from beyond the arc, and added eight rebounds. Caden Harris shot 5 for 7, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 12 points. Kaleb Jeffries finished with 24 points and two steals for the Bulldogs. Up next North Alabama hosts Tusculum in its next matchup on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
